card.name: Linking words before heart-rhythm terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, to, including, and, or -threatening that come right before a heart problem term like arrhythmia, cardiac failure or ventricular tachycardia. They appear in cardiac toxicity and QT warnings.

modes.label: Of/to before cardiac terms
modes.description: A preposition after a noun or verb, just before a cardiac outcome.
modes.example: which may lead<< to>> an increased risk for ventricular tach

modes.label: Including/and lists
modes.description: A list-introducing word before named rhythm problems.
modes.example: QTc interval prolongation,<< including>> Torsades de pointes, other

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before the text names a heart rhythm or cardiac problem.
